q.family.note: Family means: husband, wife and children under 18.
q.land.text: Is farm land recorded in your name or your husband's/wife's name? How much?
q.landAfter2019.text: Did you get this land after 1 February 2019? (Do not count land you inherited from your family)
q.tenant.text: Do you farm someone else's land (as a sharecropper or on rent)?
q.incomeTax.text: Did anyone in your family pay income tax last year?
q.pensionOrGovtJob.text: Does anyone in your family get a pension of ₹10,000 or more a month? Or does anyone work in, or retired from, a government or PSU job? (Do not count Group D / MTS jobs)
q.professionalOrPost.text: Does anyone in your family work as a doctor, engineer, lawyer, CA or architect? Or is anyone an MP, MLA, MLC, minister, mayor or district panchayat chair?
q.bankEkyc.text: Is your bank account linked to Aadhaar, and is e-KYC done?
q.season.text: Which season's crop are you sowing now?
q.hasKcc.text: Do you have a Kisan Credit Card (KCC) or a crop loan now?
q.soilTest.text: When was the soil of your field last tested?
consent.title: Save on this phone?
consent.text: Your answers stay only on this phone. They are not sent anywhere. You can delete them at any time.
home.saved: Your answers are saved on this phone.
delete.confirmTitle: Do you really want to delete?
delete.confirmText: All your answers and your Haqdaar ID will be deleted from this phone. They cannot be brought back.
delete.done: Your data was deleted from this phone.
results.notSaved: Could not save on this phone. The results are shown for now.
results.likelyNote: These are only likely results. The government department makes the final decision.
